description: Increase in L2G score per unit of expression specificity in the biosample, adjusted for gene length and gene density
Biosample identifier of the tissue or cell type tested
Resolution of the specificity panel the biosample belongs to (tissue or celltype)
Expression dataset the specificity scores come from
Number of protein-coding genes with an L2G score in the study, or in its pooled group
Number of studies with the same diseases whose L2G scores were pooled; 1 when not pooled
Bonferroni-adjusted p-value across the panel's biosamples within the study
Benjamini-Hochberg q-value across the panel's biosamples within the study
Standard error of beta, counting genes in the same 1 Mb region as one
Beta divided by its standard error
